user.title: Bambu Filament Manager
user.description:
Bambu Lab printers found: {count} ({printers}).

The integration manages your filament spools, reads AMS slots, NFC stickers and the usage per print. Afterwards the “Bambu Filament” card is available in your dashboard.

no_printer.title: No Bambu Lab printer found yet
no_printer.description:
This integration builds on the **Bambu Lab** integration (ha-bambulab, via HACS). The printer connection is set up there:

1. HACS → install **Bambu Lab** and restart Home Assistant.
2. On the printer: Settings → **LAN only / developer mode** – it shows the **IP address** and the **access code**. The **serial number** is under device info.
3. Settings → Devices & services → add **Bambu Lab** → choose “Local (LAN)” → enter IP, serial number and access code.

The printer then shows up here automatically. You can continue now – the printer is detected later.
